latestVersion.changelog:
Free to Editing 1.0.0 — First Release

- Launches a cloud-powered video editing tool for quick, AI-assisted edits and 1080p MP4 exports.
- Supports popular formats (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM) up to 500MB; processing completes in 1–2 minutes.
- Handles authentication, session setup, and cloud API interaction automatically.
- Maps user prompts to upload, edit, export, check credits, and show session status actions.
- Includes robust error handling and clear feedback for file, session, or subscription issues.
- Guides users through upload, edit, and export workflows with concise instructions and summaries.
